mkdir -p /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body
rm -f /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md
gh issue view 1464 --json body --jq '.body' > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md \
  || gh issue view 1464 --json body --jq '.body' > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md
echo "--- head of cache ---"; head -c 120 /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md; echo; echo " …[per-command-truncated]

gh issue view 1464 --json body --jq '.body' > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md; echo "rc=$?"; wc -c /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md; head -c 100 /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md
gh issue view 1464 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md; echo "rc=$?"; wc -c .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1464.md

git fetch origin "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main" 2>&1 | tail -2
BRANCH=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/branch-for-issue.py 1464 --title-file .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-1464-title.txt); echo "BRANCH=$BRANCH"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH" origin/main 2>&1 | tail -2
git branch --show-current

sed -n '1,60p' .changeset/README.md 2>/dev/null; echo "=== sample changesets ==="; ls .changeset/ | head; echo "=== one example ==="; f=$(ls .changeset/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v README | head -1); echo "FILE: $f"; cat "$f"

BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
if [ "$BRANCH" = HEAD ] || [ -z "$BRANCH" ]; then
  printf 'detached HEAD (no branch to push)\npush: failed\n'
elif PUSH_ERR=$(git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH" 2>&1); then
  printf 'push: ok\n'
else
  printf '%s\npush: failed\n' "$PUSH_ERR"
fi

BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main); [ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=main
gh pr create --base "$BASE" --draft --title "Correct the stale labeling rationale in the create-issue issue template" --body-file .prflow/tmp/pr-body-1464.md 2>&1; echo "create-rc=$?"

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1464 \
  --reflection-kind note --reflection "Verification evidence: lib/test/run-parallel.sh — aggregate CLEAN, 18198 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; 5/5 shards covered (monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest); retained-log root .prflow/tmp/parallel-suite/run-63832-0/logs; launch start 2026-08-09 ~05:33 UTC. Zero skips means the #434 stale-prose self-scan ran (not skipped)."; echo rc=$?

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1464/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id')
echo "trigger id: $TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --report-failure 2>&1; echo "react-rc=$?"
